rationale: At the 0.45 floor, tight runs are limited by a reg-to-reg path at ss 100C max-RC; ports stop mattering. The best run (md5 recipe: AREA 3 with ABC buffering/sizing, timing-driven placement, both post-GRT repairs, cap213) beat its target by 0.83 ns using margins 0.2/0.25, versus 0.56 ns at 0.18/0.09, so the resizer is not at its limit and over-delivery tracks margin. With the target pinned, both settings push PL/GRT setup margins to 0.4. Hold (+0.09, no buffers), DRC (0) and slew/cap (0 vs 953) leave headroom. Setting 1 changes only margins; setting 2 also compacts placement (util 38, density 52%; the 55%-density run had ~10% shorter wires) and tightens slew/cap targets to cut wire and transition delay.
